name: cwd-malformed-percent-encoding
description: A cwd whose percent-encoding is malformed ('%zz' is not a hex escape) is kept as the raw header value rather than emptied, so the row still records something recognisable.
grounding: A decoding failure is non-fatal: the reader falls back to the raw header value. That fallback still passes the control-byte guard, so no path through the decoder can yield a control byte.
notes: direction is decode because a conformant producer never emits a malformed escape. There is no error block: nothing is rejected and no field is dropped — the field simply does not receive a decoded value, which is neither of the two dispositions the schema defines. Retaining the still-escaped string beats emptying it when an operator is trying to work out which producer emitted it.
